action.command:
cat > /opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28/config/elasticsearch.yml <<'EOF'
cluster.name: index-data-explorer
node.name: node-1
path.data: /opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28/data
path.logs: /opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28/logs
network.host: 127.0.0.1
http.port: 9200
discovery.type: single-node
http.cors.enabled: true
http.cors.allow-origin: "http://localhost"
http.cors.allow-headers: "Authorization,X-Requested-With,Content-Type,Content-Length,X-Elastic-Client-Meta"
http.cors.max-age: 1728000
EOF
chown elastic:elastic /opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28/config/elasticsearch.yml
cd /opt/es && su -s /bin/bash elastic -c "ES_JAVA_OPTS='-Xms1g -Xmx1g' /opt/es/bin/elasticsearch -d -p /opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28/elasticsearch.pid" >/var/log/es_start3.log 2>&1; echo "start exit: $?"; sleep 12; curl -s --max-time 5 http://localhost:9200/ | head -3
